lines: Joining should take about a minute, and end with you signed in.
Open Join and the member app shows the form from the mock: name, email, password, home church and what you are into.
Home church is optional. Leave it blank, and the account has none.
Press Create profile, and the button says Creating your profile until the answer arrives.
Then you land on Home, signed in, greeted by your first name.
One request creates the account, keeps only a hash of the password, and sets a secure session cookie.
This is the first screen that calls the API, so a failing load now shows Something went wrong, and keeps the address.
The HTTP client and the first form bring the first load to two hundred and fifty-five kilobytes.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
Next, slice two point two refuses invalid details.
That's slice two point one. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
